story: The Black Baza (Aviceda leuphotes) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Accipitridae family. It is most commonly observed in Forests; woodland; cultivated areas; and open country, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Black Baza is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists.
